title: Император Галактики  (The Emperor of the Galaxy)

segments.t: Aboard the intergalactic restaurant in the year 2114, Chef Barinov calls out alien seafood dishes to his cooks until a glowing hologram of Dmitry Nagiyev beams in with an urgent warning.
Федя, где треска в марсианской соли?
Скоро к нам прилетит император галактики!
Let's examine each line of the space-kitchen orders.
Федя, где треска в марсианской соли?
'Fedya, where is the cod in Martian salt?' Even on Mars a hundred years from now, Fedya is still frying cod in the kitchen.
'Lyova, will the chicken be ready soon?' The feminine short-form adjective 'ready' agrees with 'chicken'.
'Yes, chef, just a couple more seconds.' In everyday Russian, 'chef' flows straight into 'seconds' without extra linking words.
'Chef, Nagiyev is calling you right now.' Lyova points to the futuristic communicator.
Скоро к нам прилетит император галактики!
'Soon the Emperor of the Galaxy will fly in to us!' The verb 'will arrive by air/space' fits an intergalactic VIP.
'Dima, you have to warn me in advance!' Here Chef Barinov anchors the thought on 'need to, must' and finishes on 'to warn', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
'Vitya, that is completely impossible.' Hologram Nagiyev shakes his head at the complaint.
'The lifespan of these creatures is seven hours.' Nagiyev pairs 'life' with 'hours' directly, since spoken Russian skips English filler words like 'the', 'a', and 'is'.
'Born, ate a meal, and died right away.' Three rapid masculine past-tense verbs summarize the alien emperor's seven-hour life.
'Do not worry, Dima, we will do everything.' Here Chef Barinov anchors the thought on 'worry' and finishes on 'to do, to make', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
'We will host the guest in first-class style!' The idiom 'by the highest grade' means 'first-class' or 'royally'.
'Right, otherwise it is the end for all of us.' The conjunction 'otherwise' warns of galactic consequences if dinner is late. Now listen to the whole space-kitchen scene again at natural speed.
Федя, где треска в марсианской соли?
Скоро к нам прилетит император галактики!
Notice the Russian idiom 'by the highest grade', which is how you promise to treat a guest to royal, first-class service. Until next time!

lines.fragment: Дима, ну, о таких вещах надо
